choose.when: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM member WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH) GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
choose.otherwise: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM member WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY label ORDER BY label

choose.when: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(withdrawn_at, '%Y-%m') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM member WHERE withdrawn_at IS NOT NULL AND withdrawn_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH) GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
choose.otherwise: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(withdrawn_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM member WHERE withdrawn_at IS NOT NULL AND withdrawn_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY label ORDER BY label

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE deleted = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE deleted = 1 AND subscribe = #{subscribe}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE deleted = 1 AND subscribe = 0 AND ai_count >= 3
SELECT job FROM member WHERE deleted = 1 AND job IS NOT NULL AND job != ''

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS matchCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.status = 'CLOSED' THEN m.id END) AS closedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.status = 'CLOSED' AND mb.status = 'SELECTED' THEN mb.bid_price END), 0) AS totalBidAmount FROM `match` m LEFT JOIN match_bid mb ON mb.match_id = m.id AND mb.deleted = 1 WHERE m.deleted = 1 AND m.created_at >= #{startDate} AND m.user_id IN
#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `match` WHERE deleted = 1 AND status = #{status}
SELECT AVG(bid_price) FROM match_bid WHERE deleted = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_lawyers ml JOIN member m ON ml.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.deleted = 1
SELECT ml.sido AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM member_lawyers ml JOIN member m ON ml.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.deleted = 1 GROUP BY ml.sido ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT ml.specialty AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM member_lawyers ml JOIN member m ON ml.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.deleted = 1 GROUP BY ml.specialty ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT AVG(ml.experience_years) FROM member_lawyers ml JOIN member m ON ml.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.deleted = 1
